title: Welcome, Commander, to Crownspire!
body:
Welcome to your new Citadel! As Lord of the Crownspire, you are charged with defending the realm against the invading Wildling hordes and securing the Crystallite Spire. Use these starter resources to lay the foundations of your empire.

May light guide your blade!

title: Server Maintenance Compensation
body: Greetings, Commander. The Citadel underwent a scheduled database synchronization and upgrade to Version 1.4.2. We apologize for any temporary inconvenience this downtime caused your legions. Please accept this compensation package.

title: Victory: Skirmish at Wildling Outpost #3
body: We have successfully cleared the Wildling encampment on our eastern border! Our vanguard forces fought with extreme courage. The enemy fled back into the frozen wastes, leaving behind substantial war spoils.

title: Alliance Chest Distribution: Level 3 Chest
body:
Commander, your fellow alliance member Sir Balin purchased a special store package! This triggered a shared Alliance Gift distribution for all members. Claim your shared materials below.

Strength in Unity!
